description: Enterprise Data Quality Engine Business Rules Specification.

rules.name: Customer Identifier Mandatory Check
rules.business_impact: Missing customer identifiers prevent order tracking, billing, and reporting.
rules.recommendation: Missing Customer ID -> Make Customer No. a mandatory field in ERP ingestion.

rules.name: Customer & Site Compound Key Uniqueness
rules.business_impact: Duplicate customer site records cause routing errors and invoice splits.
rules.recommendation: Duplicate Customer Site Key -> Enforce UNIQUE compound index on (Customer No., Add. Code).

rules.name: Quantity Ordered Numeric Type Check
rules.business_impact: Non-numeric order quantities break inventory planning and revenue calculation.
rules.recommendation: Non-Numeric Quantity -> Convert and validate quantity columns as numeric types.

rules.name: Quantity Ordered Non-Negative Range
rules.business_impact: Negative order quantities cause inventory underflow and negative revenue reporting.
rules.recommendation: Negative Quantity -> Enforce Quantity > 0 validation rule on order submission.

rules.name: Customer Email Format Pattern
rules.business_impact: Invalid email formats cause customer notification and billing failures.
rules.recommendation: Missing Email -> Make Email mandatory and validate format against standard regex.

rules.name: Order Status Allowed Values
rules.business_impact: Invalid status values disrupt operational workflow automation.
rules.recommendation: Invalid Status -> Enforce controlled lookup vocabulary for status columns.

rules.name: Expected Delivery Date >= Order Date
rules.business_impact: Delivery dates prior to order creation indicate corrupted log data.
rules.recommendation: Invalid Date Order -> Validate Expected Delivery Date >= Order Date.

rules.name: Ship Date >= Order Date
rules.business_impact: Shipment dates preceding order entry cause false fulfillment SLA metrics.
rules.recommendation: Invalid Ship Date -> Validate Ship Date >= Order Date.

rules.name: Expected Delivery Date >= SO Date Created
rules.business_impact: Expected delivery preceding sales order creation causes SLA distortion.
rules.recommendation: Invalid Delivery Timeline -> Validate Expected Delivery Date >= SO Date Created.

rules.name: Discount Amount <= Total Amount
rules.business_impact: Discounts exceeding order totals result in negative invoice balances.
rules.recommendation: Discount > Total -> Enforce Discount <= Total Amount boundary check.

rules.name: Invoice Date <= Today
rules.business_impact: Post-dated invoices corrupt financial accounting periods.
rules.recommendation: Future Invoice Date -> Reject invoice dates greater than today's date.
